summary.text: Alisa Mitskog is a Democratic member of the North Dakota House of Representatives who has represented District 25 since December 1, 2014 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Mitskog's 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Appropriations - Human Resources Division Committee.
